title: Lebesgue differentiation along closed balls for finite measures on ℝ^P
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let ν be a finite Borel measure on ℝ^P, and let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be ν-integrable. Then for ν-almost every x, (∫⁻_{B̄_s(x)} ‖g(z) − g(x)‖ₑ dν(z)) / ν(B̄_s(x)) → 0 in [0, ∞] as s → 0⁺.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (g : Eucl P → ℝ), Integrable g ν → ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ z in closedBall x s, ‖g z - g x‖ₑ ∂ν) / ν (closedBall x s)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
